verdict.rationale: Amazon IVS is an API-driven cloud service, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question. The evidence pack does not show one: the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the docs describe the IVS API only in prose. The llms.txt file is a documentation index, not an API specification, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
